candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order POST /v1/orders fails with HTTP 500; the order service is the origin of the error, propagated to the gateway as 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side root cause (db, payment, inventory) not observed; only gateway-side evidence available.

report.explanation: Traces and logs consistently show gateway POST /v1/checkout returning 502 immediately after a downstream POST /v1/orders to order returning 500. Metrics show checkout 502s alongside 200s. Topology confirms gateway->order dependency. The proximate failing component is the order service returning 500; gateway 502 is a propagation.
